Name: MissingNo Farmer
Author: paradigmnomad
Description:
This is a silly/joke mod. Your farmer will appear as MissingNo.
Shirts, pants, accessories, hair, and hats are disabled but can be enabled. If you're using GetGlam or JA shirts/pants/hats those will be visible. You'll have to change them out for a vanilla item if you want the true experience.

You'll need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] for this to work.

Manifest.Name: Farmer MissingNo Replacement
Manifest.Description: A joke mod that replaces the farmer with a smaller redition of MissingNo.
